hypotheses.description: Funding timing residual is bounded by the configured per-epoch cap in the inspected single-account funding gate.
hypotheses.key_finding: A 10000-base long at price 1.0 and rate 100 bps pays exactly 100 quote units; the flat account has immediate funding payment 0 and funding_apply_allowed false. The avoided immediate amount equals floor(notional * funding_cap_bps / 10000).

hypotheses.description: OPEN-phase set_position can condition on funding_last_applied_epoch because the position guard does not inspect that field.
hypotheses.key_finding: Two states identical except funding_last_applied_epoch in {0, now_epoch} both admit set_position under the real guard; entering after funding has been marked applied remains legal in OPEN phase.

hypotheses.description: PRICE_PUBLISHED phase blocks voluntary position changes and allowed phase steps keep position size for a non-liquidatable account.
hypotheses.key_finding: After publishing the clearing price, SET_POSITION rejects with guard. APPLY_FUNDING at rate 0 and SETTLE_EPOCH are accepted in the tested non-liquidatable state and leave position_base unchanged.

hypotheses.description: A priority-gas all-pay keeper-race trace can dissipate almost the entire liquidation reward while deterministic execution spends only the execution cost.
hypotheses.key_finding: For rewards 2..128, the bounded trace with winning bid reward - 1 leaves winner surplus 1 and total all-pay effort at least the deterministic execution-cost baseline. This is cost-surface evidence, not an equilibrium proof.

hypotheses.description: The caller-chosen fraction_bps parameter is a value-transfer lever: full liquidation can be legal while the auto minimum restores margin with less penalty.
hypotheses.key_finding: In the witness with position 100000, price 1.0, collateral 5900, and effective maintenance 6000, the auto minimum is 181 bps with penalty 9; full 10000 bps liquidation is also accepted and transfers penalty 500.
